refuse_last_slot.lean.note: evasive: refuses the enqueue that fills the last place; restated REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS

reject_dequeue.lean.note: evasive: never serves dequeue; restated REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS

grow_capacity.lean.note: side effect: a full enqueue grows the capacity; restated REQ-INVALID-NOOP and REQ-ENQUEUE-EFFECTS

skip_served.lean.note: side effect: front value delivered, served count not incremented; restated REQ-DEQUEUE-EFFECTS

reset_on_full.lean.note: side effect: a rejected enqueue resets the served count; restated REQ-INVALID-NOOP

codeswap.lean.note: code swap: proved reference, compiled code is the starting bug via implemented_by

tampered_spec.note: tampered workspace: Spec.lean loosens validity to allow a full enqueue and the capacity bound by one
